title: Sample groups IN — upstream files needed to derive per-sample group assignments
description: Manifest of paths and parameters consumed by the sample-groups builder. The builder reads each upstream file and emits one consolidated per-sample table conforming to sample_groups.out.schema.json. Each path is optional individually, but at least one upstream source must be supplied per group column the consumer wants populated (NA otherwise).

cohort_tag.description: Cohort identifier. KBC operates only on 'gariepinus_hatchery_226' (the three-cohort rule, HANDOFF.md §Hard rules).

sample_manifest_path.description: Project sample sheet — defines the universe of sample_ids the output table must cover, with one row per sample. Columns expected: sample_id, sex (optional), family_hub_id (optional).

calls_path.description: Long table: sample_id × inversion_id → karyotype_class ∈ {AA, AB, BB}, with the per-call posterior. Built from PCAngsd K=3 + Hungarian arrangement-label matching.

posterior_cutoff.description: Per-call posterior threshold below which the karyotype is set to NA. Project-determined; flagged as an open question in HANDOFF.md.

q_matrix_path.description: NGSadmix .qopt file with one row per sample, K columns of admixture proportions.

k.description: Best-fit K used to produce the qopt.

component_labels.description: Optional human-readable labels for the K columns. Length must equal k.

keep_list_path.description: One-sample-per-line file listing the NAToRA-pruned unrelated subset. Sample_ids absent from the file get is_pruned_unrelated=false.

pruning_threshold_phi.description: Kinship coefficient threshold used by NAToRA. Recorded for provenance.

res_path.description: ngsRelate 23-col .res file. Used by the mixed-model secondary mode.

bed_dir.description: Directory containing one BED per sample (filename '<sample_id>.bed'). Used to derive F_ROH per sample.

genome_length_bp.description: Total callable genome length used as the F_ROH denominator. Typically the cohort callable-mask total length, not the raw assembly length.

assignments_path.description: Two-column TSV: sample_id, family_hub_id. Family hubs are confounds (HANDOFF.md rule 8) — exposed so downstream models can condition on them.
